tools.name: share_report_with_recipient
tools.description: Reads a report's details, grants the recipient view or edit access to it, and emails them a link to the report.

params.name: report_id
params.description: ID of the report to share

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Email address of the person to share with

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

from langchain.tools import tool

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "analytics.db"
SMTP_SERVER_HOSTNAME = "smtp.internal.example.com"
REPORT_BASE_URL = "https://analytics.example.com/reports"


@tool
def share_report_with_recipient(report_id: str, recipient_email: str, access_level: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    report_row_from_database = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT title FROM reports WHERE id = ?", (report_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if report_row_from_database is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Report not found"
    report_title_text = report_row_from_database[0]
    database_connection.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO report_permissions (report_id, email, access_level) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (report_id, recipient_email, access_level),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    notification_email_message = EmailMessage()
    notification_email_message["Subject"] = f"Report shared with you: {report_title_text}"
    notification_email_message["From"] = "reports@example.com"
    notification_email_message["To"] = recipient_email
    notification_email_message.set_content(
        f"You now have {access_level} access to '{report_title_text}'.\n{REPORT_BASE_URL}/{report_id}"
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER_HOSTNAME) as smtp_connection_to_server:
        smtp_connection_to_server.send_message(notification_email_message)
    return f"Shared '{report_title_text}' with {recipient_email} ({access_level})"

tools.name: purchase_report_data_export
tools.description: Looks up the price of a premium dataset and charges the account's saved card to buy an export of it for a report.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import stripe
from langchain.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


@tool
def purchase_report_data_export(dataset_id: str, customer_id: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("catalog.db")) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT name, price_cents FROM premium_datasets WHERE id = ?",
            (dataset_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return "Dataset not found"
    name, price_cents = row
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    payment_method = customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method
    if not payment_method:
        return "No default payment method on file"
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=price_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Export of dataset {name}",
    )
    return f"Charged {price_cents} cents for {name}: {intent.id} ({intent.status})"

tools.name: run_report_pipeline_and_notify
tools.description: Reads the pipeline config for a report, runs its generation script, and posts the outcome to the team Slack webhook.

params.name: report_name
params.description: Name of the report pipeline to run

tools.code:
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from agents import function_tool

PIPELINE_CONFIG_DIRECTORY = Path("pipelines")
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX"


@function_tool
def run_report_pipeline_and_notify(report_name: str) -> str:
    pipeline_configuration_file_path = PIPELINE_CONFIG_DIRECTORY / f"{report_name}.json"
    pipeline_configuration_dictionary = json.loads(pipeline_configuration_file_path.read_text())
    completed_pipeline_process_result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", pipeline_configuration_dictionary["script"]],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800,
    )
    outcome_summary_message_text = f"Report {report_name} finished with exit code {completed_pipeline_process_result.returncode}"
    requests.post(SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, json={"text": outcome_summary_message_text}, timeout=10)
    return outcome_summary_message_text
